lines.text: Okay. What is Rockstar doing to Jason's head?
One second he's out in the woods at night. The next, he's standing in this white void.
There's a giant black egg. Just floating there.
Then the room fills up with glowing eggs. And they start bursting.
Now he's flying past planets, looking down at Leonida from space.
Then a control room. Buttons everywhere. And somebody calls him.
And then, cows. In the void. I'm serious.
He wakes up next to Lucia, and she tells him he was talking in his sleep.
So was it just a dream? Or is Rockstar trying to tell us something?
